_readme: Hand-entered from the City of San Mateo Local Roadway Safety Plan (adopted May 20, 2024). Location names and ranks are copied from Table 6 (page 48) and Table 7 (page 50); proposed changes are plain-language summaries of Table 9 (pages 75-76). 'streets' are the two names pipeline/plans.py matches against OpenStreetMap. Statuses are only recorded when completed, with where and when they were checked. Rerun: pipeline/.venv/bin/python pipeline/plans.py
title: Local Roadway Safety Plan
method: The plan ranked locations by a severity-weighted score of police-reported crashes from 2017 through 2021, so its order differs from the counts on this site.
